why: DeepSeek V4 (Flash, Pro and the Flash Vision preview) ships no chat template. It encodes chats in Python, which vLLM carries as its deepseek_v4 tokenizer mode, and writes tool calls and thinking in its own format.

args.why: The repos have no chat_template, so without this vLLM has no way to turn a chat request into a prompt.
vLLM refuses requests that let the model choose a tool unless a tool-call parser is set.
This separates the model's thinking from its answer.
